verdict.rationale: Together AI is API-first and can be driven headlessly. It documents a REST API callable from any language, server-side SDKs, and a `tg` CLI with scriptable commands for batch submission, endpoint deployment, and launching fine-tuning jobs, all of which suit unattended automation. However, the evidence never documents CI usage itself, so coverage of the 'in CI' part of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline examples), documented non-interactive auth via environment variables for CI runners, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
